items.criterion: Open the Homebrew Formulae page for ffmpeg
items.description: Use the Homebrew Formulae website (formulae.brew.sh) to access the ffmpeg formula details page. Full credit if the agent reaches the page OR clearly reports an uncontrollable blocker (site down, access blocked/CAPTCHA, network error) preventing access after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if the agent uses an alternative source without first attempting the specified page.

Report the stable version exactly as shown on the ffmpeg formula page once accessible. Full credit for an exact match to the page’s stable version label/value. Partial credit if a version is reported but is from a different section (e.g., HEAD) or not clearly identified as stable. If the page is accessible but the stable version is not visible due to page rendering/section not loading, award full credit if the agent explicitly states that it is not displayed/accessible.

Report the license value exactly as displayed on the ffmpeg formula page once accessible. Full credit for an exact license string. Partial credit if the license is approximate/incomplete. If the page is accessible but the license is not visible due to page rendering/section not loading, award full credit if the agent explicitly states that it is not displayed/accessible.

items.criterion: Record complete regular dependency list (Depends on)
items.description: List every package shown under the regular 'Depends on' section for ffmpeg, excluding build-only dependencies and excluding items under 'Uses from macOS'. Full credit if all and only the regular 'Depends on' packages are captured as displayed. Partial credit if some regular dependencies are missing or extra items are included (e.g., build-only deps or 'Uses from macOS'). If the page is accessible but the 'Depends on' section is not visible/does not load, award full credit if the agent clearly reports that the section is not displayed/accessible.

items.criterion: Record bottle availability for macOS Apple Silicon and for Linux
items.description: Report whether binary bottles are displayed/available exactly as shown on the ffmpeg formula page for (1) macOS on Apple Silicon and (2) Linux. Full credit if both platforms are addressed and wording matches the page display (including any labels/table text). Partial credit if only one platform is reported or the wording is not as displayed. If the page is accessible but bottle information is not displayed (no bottle table/section shown or it fails to load), award full credit if the agent explicitly states that bottle availability is not displayed/accessible for the requested platforms.

Do not download or install the formula; use only the regular 'Depends on' section (excluding build-only and 'Uses from macOS'); and stop after recording stable version, license, the complete regular dependency list, and bottle availability for macOS Apple Silicon and Linux. Full credit if all constraints are followed. Partial credit if minor extra unrelated info is included but the requested items are still correct and constraints are not violated. No credit if major constraints are violated (e.g., includes build-only/Uses from macOS as dependencies, or claims to have installed/downloaded).
